name: 15332 · Finleyville, PA
findings: ZIP 15332 (Finleyville) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15332 (Finleyville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 15332 (Finleyville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).
